headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: BJP has sought Kharge’s public apology over Modi’s father remarks.
Woman, daughter arrested for thefts in trains, gold worth ₹10.6 lakh recovered.
Controversy mars Punganur municipal election after TDP’s uncontested sweep.
CPI(M) accuses TDP cadre of obstructing nominations in local body polls.
bullets_ur: BJP ne Modi ke walid par diye gaye bayan par Kharge se sar-e-aam maafi ka mutaliba kiya hai.
Trainon mein chori ke ilzaam mein khatoon aur beti thekay par giraftar, 10.6 lakh rupay ka sona baramad.
TDP ki be-muqabla jeet ke baad Punganur municipal election mein tanqeed samne aa gayi.
CPI(M) ne TDP karkunon par muqami body intikhabat mein nominations mein rukawatein dalne ka ilzam lagaya
